text: Ground floor of our building had water for 5 days. Cars in the stilt parking were damaged.
Mosquitoes everywhere for weeks after the water went down.
We depend on tankers in summer, around 800 rupees a load.
Power was switched off for almost a day during the heavy rain.
Our street was knee-deep again. It cleared in about 2 days.
The subway near us was closed for two days.
Top-floor flats get very hot. AC is a must from March.
Short power cuts during heavy rain, mostly at night.
Very little shade on the streets. Walking at noon is hard.
Our road had ankle-deep water for a few hours only.
Metro water comes on alternate days. We keep a sump.
The sea breeze in the evening helps a lot.
Water stayed in our lane for a full week. We moved to a relative's house.
Two people on our street got dengue after the water finally drained.
No power for three days. We charged phones at a shop on OMR.
Water came into the ground floor shops on our road within an hour of the rain.
Knee-deep water in the house during Fengal. Drains were still under construction.
Our housing board colony was under water for three days.
Borewell water turns yellow in summer. Tankers twice a week.
Parking area flooded after one hour of rain. It drained by evening.
Evenings are fine near the beach, but the afternoons are still brutal.
